channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: MNLGA, Schaefer Center for Public Policy evaluate Maryland's landscaping business
item.description: The 2024 Statistical Profile and Economic Survey of the Maryland Horticulture Industry provides a detailed look at sales trends, workforce conditions and more.

item.title: Toro to give away Dingo TX 450 at American Rental Association Show
item.description: Attendees can visit the Toro booth (4626) at the ARA Show.

item.title: Truce Software closes Series B funding round
item.description: The round was led by Yttrium, with participation from other existing institutional investors, including Allomer Capital Group and New Amsterdam Growth Capital.

item.title: Housecall Pro releases new integration with Yelp
item.description: The feature enables leads from Yelp's users to flow directly into Housecall Pro's Job Inbox.

item.title: Truly Lawn expands with 3 Massachusetts acquisitions
item.description: Truly Lawn has acquired TurfDoctor of Mendon, LawnMaster of Methuen, and LawnPhix of Hopedale.

item.title: Mullin names Scott Miller as COO
item.description: Miller will oversee all operational functions across the company's commercial landscape maintenance, construction and industrial services divisions.

item.title: Hittle Landscaping acquires Calvin Landscape in Indianapolis
item.description: The partnership with Calvin marks Hittle’s first add-on acquisition and comes after CID Capital invested in Hittle last fall.

item.title: Granum to host 4-day virtual series on preparing landscape teams for spring
item.description: The event, hosted by Sam Gembel and Brian Fullerton, is a free live webinar series running from March 3-6.

item.title: NCLC set for milestone competition at Michigan State this March
item.description: This year's event marks a 50-year celebration that will bring together 800 of the nation’s horticulture and landscape students from approximately 60 schools.

item.title: Envu set to host mosquito add-on services webinar Thursday
item.description: The free virtual event will cover mosquito service trends and mosquito biology.
